relations.statement: On a pairwise separated regime, distinct marks i≠j below r.data are not collapsed (separated marks are not one internal class).
The identity convention is a declared two-valued choice (opaqueConv or exactInscription), not derived from the other hypotheses.

lemmas.statement: For a pairwise separated alphabet, distinct admitted marks are not Collapsed, so the opaque and exact-inscription conventions agree on those marks.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem conv_agree {r : GenesisComputation.GenesisCopy.Regime} (h : GenesisComputation.PairwiseSeparated r) {i j : Nat} (hi : i < r.data) (hj : j < r.data) (hij : i ≠ j) : ¬ GenesisComputation.Collapsed r i j := GenesisComputation.separated_marks_not_collapsed h hi hj hij
